title_zh: 把停车调查结论限定为受访者意见

scenario.label_zh: 把广泛支持结论限定为已访谈者观点
scenario.goal_zh: 商定删除无法支持的普遍赞同说法，报告已访谈者观点并补充招募方式

context_zh: 两名社区研究志愿者核对小规模访谈的摘要。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: My draft says there's universal support for removing the parking spaces.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: We spoke to eight people at a cycling event. That's one viewpoint, not the whole neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Could I say support is widespread instead?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: We don't know that either. The idea may be widely discussed, but discussion isn't agreement.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Then I'll write that all eight people we interviewed supported it, and explain where we found them.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Yes. Add that we haven't yet heard from drivers or nearby shop owners.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll remove the broad claim and keep those limits visible.
